name: Fill
brief: An abstract class representing the gradient fill of the Shape object.
description: It contains the information about the gradient colors and their arrangement inside the gradient bounds. The gradients bounds are defined in the LinearGradient or RadialGradient class, depending on the type of the gradient to be used. It specifies the gradient behavior in case the area defined by the gradient bounds is smaller than the area to be filled.

members.name: colorStops
members.signature: Result colorStops(const ColorStop* colorStops, uint32_t cnt) noexcept
members.brief: Sets the parameters of the colors of the gradient and their position.

params.name: colorStops
params.description: An array of ColorStop data structure.

params.name: cnt
params.description: The count of the `colorStops` array equal to the colors number used in the gradient.

members.name: spread
members.brief: Sets the FillSpread value, which specifies how to fill the area outside the gradient bounds.

members.name: transform
members.brief: Sets the matrix of the affine transformation for the gradient fill.
description: The augmented matrix of the transformation is expected to be given.

members.name: colorStops
members.signature: uint32_t colorStops(const ColorStop** colorStops = nullptr) const noexcept
members.brief: Gets the parameters of the colors of the gradient, their position and number.

params.name: colorStops
params.description: A pointer to the memory location, where the array of the gradient's ColorStop is stored.

members.returns: The number of colors used in the gradient. This value corresponds to the length of the `colorStops` array.

members.name: spread
members.brief: Gets the FillSpread value of the fill.
members.returns: The FillSpread value of this Fill.

members.name: transform
members.brief: Gets the matrix of the affine transformation of the gradient fill.
description: In case no transformation was applied, the identity matrix is returned.

members.name: duplicate
members.brief: Creates a copy of the Fill object.
description: Return a newly created Fill object with the properties copied from the original.
members.returns: A copied Fill object when succeed, `nullptr` otherwise.

members.name: type
members.brief: Returns the ID value of this class.
description: This method can be used to check the current concrete instance type.
members.returns: The class type ID of the Fill instance.
